name: When is a room addition a better choice than moving to a new home?

mainEntity.name: When is a room addition a better choice than moving to a new home?

acceptedAnswer.text: A room addition can be a better choice than moving if you love your current neighborhood, have children in local schools, or prefer to avoid the significant costs and hassle associated with selling and buying a new home. If your existing property has sufficient space for expansion and an addition can meet your needs for more square footage, it can be a more cost-effective and less disruptive solution. It allows you to tailor the new space precisely to your preferences while staying in a familiar environment.
acceptedAnswer.description: A room addition is often better than moving if you love your current location, want to avoid relocation costs, and have space for expansion.
